description: This file defines the IOrderService interface, which declares an asynchronous method for creating orders in the eShopOnWeb application. It serves as a contract for implementing order-related operations, specifically order creation with a given basket ID and shipping address.

classes.name: IOrderService
classes.description: Interface specifying order creation operation for the application.

methods.name: CreateOrderAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to create an order with specified basket ID and shipping address.
